title: John is a man sent from God to bear witness
speaker: God, as narrated by the evangelist
note: Johannine counterpart of Mark 1:2–4, already linked here; AUD-47-1-29 (1:33, 'He who sent me to baptize') is the alternative home.

title: Jerusalem's leaders send priests and Levites to question John
speaker: the Jews of Jerusalem, from the Pharisees
recipient: priests and Levites sent to John
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 1:19–22 outside candidate list (linked only to ot-isaiah-v40-3 for the voice saying); 1:22 'those who sent us'; 1:24 sent from the Pharisees.

title: Jesus teaches Nicodemus about birth from above
speaker: Jesus
note: Widen B21 P02763's extension (3:5–15) to start at 3:3, the first 'born from above' saying, which 3:5–7 explains.

title: Jesus answers Sabbath critics: my Father is working, and I work
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the Jews persecuting him over a Sabbath healing
note: John 5's Sabbath dispute lacks the Sabbath-teaching record other controversies have (K013, K014, AUD-46-13-10, K015).

title: Jesus recalls choosing the Twelve, though one is a devil
speaker: Jesus
note: John narrates no appointment of the Twelve; 6:70 refers back to it (compare 13:18; 15:16).

title: Judge with righteousness rather than by appearances
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the crowd at the Feast of Tabernacles
note: 7:19 (none of you keeps the Law) and 7:21 (one work, and you all marvel) open the argument; 7:22 begins mid-thought.

title: The chief priests and Pharisees send officers to arrest Jesus
speaker: the chief priests and the Pharisees
note: B21 P02786 (7:45–49) flags this order as unrecorded; merge both as one record, John 7:32, 45–49. Compare AUD-47-11-55.

title: Abraham's true children do Abraham's works
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the Jews who claimed Abraham as their father
note: 8:42 adds 'If God were your Father, you would love Me.' Compare AUD-44-3-7 on presuming descent from Abraham.

title: Martha tells Mary that the Teacher is here and calls her
speaker: Jesus, his summons relayed by Martha
note: Relayed summons; Mary rises quickly and goes to him (11:29). Compare the summons in B20 P02645 (Mark 10:49).

title: Greeks at the feast ask Philip to let them see Jesus
speaker: some Greeks who came up to worship at the feast
note: Ordinary request, passed through Andrew to Jesus; it occasions AUD-47-12-23 (12:23–26).

title: The evangelist recalls Caiaphas's counsel that one man should die
speaker: Caiaphas, recalled by the evangelist
note: Not a separate record: add as Additional Scripture to B21 P02803 (John 11:47–53, Caiaphas's counsel) once created.

title: Annas sends Jesus bound to Caiaphas the high priest
speaker: Annas
note: Reported transfer between hearings; similar transfers (Luke 23:7, Pilate sends Jesus to Herod) are also unrecorded.

title: Everyone who is from the truth hears Jesus' voice
speaker: Jesus
note: With Jesus' stated purpose, to bear witness to the truth; compare John 8:47 and 10:27 in first-pass findings.

title: Jesus on the cross says 'I thirst' and receives sour wine
speaker: Jesus
note: Implied request, answered with sour wine on hyssop, spoken to complete the Scripture; compare B21 P02767 (John 4:7).

title: The Jews ask Pilate to break the legs and remove the bodies
speaker: the Jewish authorities
note: Outside candidate list; grounded in Deuteronomy 21:23 (C1120) and the coming Sabbath; the soldiers carry it out (19:32–33).

title: Do not break a bone of the Passover
speaker: the Lord through Moses, quoted by the evangelist
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: John applies the Passover-bone law to Jesus' unbroken legs; first pass links Exodus 12:46 and Numbers 9:12 to C0101.

title: Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus' body
speaker: Joseph of Arimathea
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Outside candidate list; Pilate permits it. Same request as B20 P02668 (Mark 15:42–46): link there rather than duplicate.

title: Stephen's opponents secretly induce men to allege blasphemy
speaker: Stephen's opponents from the synagogues (6:9)
note: Widen B21 P02849 (6:12–14, false witnesses) to 6:11–14; compare Jezebel's letters suborning witnesses (ot-1-kings-v20-9).

title: Jacob sends his sons to buy grain in Egypt
speaker: Jacob, recalled by Stephen
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Stephen's retelling of Genesis 42:1–2, like the Acts 7 retellings B21 links (P02851, P02852).

title: Heed the prophet whom God raises up like Moses
speaker: Moses, quoted by Stephen
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Stephen quotes Deuteronomy 18:15, which Peter also quotes (A109, Acts 3:22–23).

title: Damascus hearers recall Saul's errand to bring believers bound
speaker: the chief priests, as recalled by Saul's hearers in Damascus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Restates the purpose of Saul's letters (9:1–2); Paul's retellings at 22:4–5 and 26:9–12 are already linked.

title: God shows no partiality but accepts all who fear Him
speaker: Peter
note: Outside candidate list; Peter's opening maxim: in every nation whoever fears God and practices righteousness is acceptable to Him.

title: Tyre and Sidon win over Blastus and ask Herod for peace
speaker: the people of Tyre and Sidon
note: Outside candidate list; a diplomatic request, since their food came from the king's territory; it leads to Herod's address (12:21–23).

title: Israel asks for a king, and God gives them Saul
speaker: Israel, recalled by Paul
note: Outside candidate list; Paul's retelling of 1 Samuel 8 at Pisidian Antioch, like Stephen's retellings in Acts 7.

title: God raises up David as king, a man after His heart
speaker: God, quoted by Paul
note: Quotes 1 Samuel 13:14 and Greek Psalm 88:21, which B11 P01550 also links to ot-1-samuel-v16-12.

title: Paul and Barnabas appoint elders in every church with fasting
speaker: Paul and Barnabas
recipient: elders of the churches of Lystra, Iconium and Antioch
note: AUD-48-14-21's note mentions this appointment, but no record itemizes it; compare Titus 1:5 (AUD-60-1-5).

title: Carry and confirm the Jerusalem council's decision
speaker: the apostles and elders with the whole church
recipient: Judas Barsabbas and Silas, with Paul and Barnabas
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 15:30–32: the letter delivered and confirmed by word of mouth as charged (15:27); 15:33: the envoys dismissed to their senders.

title: Thessalonian brothers send Paul and Silas away by night to Berea
speaker: the brothers at Thessalonica
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Protective dispatch like 17:14 (within B22 P02876) and Acts 9:30 (also unrecorded).

title: Athenian philosophers ask Paul to explain his new teaching
speaker: Epicurean and Stoic philosophers at Athens
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 17:20–21 outside candidate list; occasions the Areopagus speech (AUD-48-17-29); compare B21 P02865 (13:15) and B22 P02908 (28:22).

title: God does not dwell in handmade sanctuaries or need human hands
speaker: Paul
note: Outside candidate list; Paul's form of Stephen's teaching (Acts 7:48–50). B22 P02876 extends AUD-48-17-29 only from 17:26.

title: Ephesian Jews ask Paul to stay; he promises to return, God willing
speaker: the Jews of the synagogue at Ephesus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 18:20 outside candidate list; hospitality request like B21 P02873 (Lydia); Paul's 'God willing' practices James 4:15 (AUD-63-4-13).

title: Paul asks the Jerusalem crowd to hear his defense
speaker: Paul
recipient: the crowd at the temple in Jerusalem
note: B22 P02888 (21:37–40) mentions this request; widen it to 21:37–22:2 or keep separate like B22 P02903 (26:1–3).

title: Agrippa notes Paul's appeal to Caesar prevents his release
speaker: King Agrippa
note: Legal effect of the appeal recorded at 25:9–12; 26:31 adds the officials' verdict that he deserves neither death nor bonds.

summary: Main gaps: the unitemized appointment of elders (Acts 14:23), the John 7:32 arrest order, the uncovered Sabbath saying of John 5:17, Passion requests (John 19:31, 19:38), and Acts 7 and 13 retellings of catalogued commands.
